frontmatter.p: AN ACT TO AMEND AND EXTEND THE OLD AGE PENSIONS ACTS, 1908 TO 1974, THE UNEMPLOYMENT ASSISTANCE ACTS, 1933 TO 1974, THE WIDOWS' AND ORPHANS' PENSIONS ACTS, 1935 TO 1974, THE SOCIAL WELFARE (CHILDREN'S ALLOWANCES) ACTS, 1944 TO 1974, AND THE SOCIAL WELFARE ACTS, 1952 TO 1974. [27th June, 1974]

sect.p: the Act of 1933 means the Unemployment Assistance Act, 1933;
the Act of 1935 means the Widows' and Orphans' Pensions Act, 1935;
the Act of 1952 means the Social Welfare Act, 1952;
the Act of 1960 means the Social Welfare (Amendment) Act, 1960;
the Act of 1966 means the Social Welfare (Occupational Injuries) Act, 1966;
the Act of 1970 means the Social Welfare Act, 1970;
the Act of 1973 means the Social Welfare Act, 1973;
the Minister means the Minister for Social Welfare.
